lines.text: Jesus the Son of God is our great high priest, so we approach the throne of grace with confidence.
Every high priest is appointed from among men to offer gifts and sacrifices for sins, including his own.
No one takes the honor of high priest upon himself; he must be called by God, just as Elijah was.
Jesus prayed with loud cries and tears to the One who could save Him from exile, and He was heard.
Made perfect, Jesus became the source of eternal salvation to all who obey Him, designated high priest in Melchizedek's order.
